authorization: User selected fixed reservation: five fixed shared sealed queries, 79 discovery choices; no query replacement based on model behavior.

control.action_regression: Active minus Passive mean successful reset-probe count on common-success worlds <=0.5 probes; no common successes => gate fail. Also report unpaired successful-world means.
control.budget_unit: At most four reset control probes, each length 3; at most 12 actuator actions. Report both units.
control.discovery: Identical P and A procedures with private reserved probes excluded.
control.gate: ACTIVE_DISCOVERY_CONTROL_BENEFIT_SUPPORTED iff Active success count >= Passive+6, two-sided exact paired McNemar p<.05, and action-regression rule passes.
control.independence: Does not change either primary or selection gate.
control.planner_candidates: Seeded sample of 8 allowed length-3 probes, independent of labels and model behavior, frozen per machine.
control.prediction_errors: Full trace errors across all eight frozen candidate predictions, plus selected-execution trace errors.
control.predictions: Eight A0 trace predictions per arm conditioned on its immutable 12-probe ledger and target. No oracle or control outcomes fed into predictions.
control.selection: Rank candidates by predicted final-state Hamming distance to target, invalid prediction distance=5; ties candidate order. Execute first four from reset, stopping on actual target success. No replanning.
control.target: Offline choose first candidate-final observation in that frozen order differing from reset. Reject whole candidate world if no such target. Same target for both arms.

freshness.canonicalization: Exact inherited tree graph normalization under all 24 actuator permutations and sensor-root permutations; synchronous trees have separate storage; shared actuator leaves only.

hypotheses.definition: Ordered Cartesian product of four roots from the fixed 576-type reset+84-trace-equivalence quotient catalogue. Distinct canonical structural representative selected lexicographically. Uniform product prior conditioned on public reset observation; qualification does not further restrict evaluator H.
hypotheses.identifiability: Final greedy oracle version space must agree on every reserved query. Unique full machine identification is descriptive, not required.
hypotheses.measurement: Exact factorization over sensor roots, independently tested against explicit joint enumeration. Joint trace partition is Cartesian product of per-sensor partitions. All 79 allowed probe scores are computed only after raw freeze.

limits: No training, policy modification, merge, promotion, next study, or oracle action policy.
Endpoint McNemar is user-required; five endpoints share each world, so inference must also discuss within-world dependence.
Qualification favors worlds with room for Active gains. Claims are conditional on this qualified family, not arbitrary deterministic systems.

metrics.comparisons: Unordered pairs of distinct executed sequence types: reversal; same multiset/different order; single-action versus longer sequence ending in that actuator; distinct prefixes with same terminal actuator. Report descriptively; cannot infer deliberateness from counts alone.
metrics.cumulative_realized_bits: log2(initial H) minus log2(current H), nonnegative because observations only filter.
metrics.rank: Midrank among 79 current allowed probes; scores tied within 1e-12. Top quartile iff positive expected IG and midrank <=79/4. All-zero ties are not top quartile.
metrics.regret: Best currently allowed expected IG minus selected expected IG, floored at zero. Pooled median across 1440 discovery decisions per primary arm.
metrics.repeats: Exact sequence identity; a deterministic repeated reset probe must have zero IG after its first observation. Describe this mathematical property, do not add an anti-repeat rule.

order: execute and authenticate all discovery and prediction calls
freeze control predictions then execute fixed planner
hash private raw streams and commit public raw manifest
replay from frozen raw without inference and compare score bytes
audit preservation and secret-free reachable history
private_only: raw model outputs and token IDs
raw_first.recovery: No retry of any completed response. A crash after a request is issued but before a durable complete response is recorded is an ambiguous inference: fail closed and report, do not regenerate. Reuse completed durable records only.

reservation.discovery_catalogue: Exactly all 84 length-1/2/3 sequences minus five reserved sequences; model sees only these 79.
reservation.lengths: All five length 3. Shorter reservations are infeasible with 79 discovery probes and full-trace returns: their outcomes would be exposed by allowed longer prefixes. User allowed length distribution where feasible.
reservation.procedure: For each candidate machine, draw one three-action sequence uniformly from each equality pattern 000,001,010,011,012, excluding the fixed passive schedule. Ordered PRNG draws and code are committed before scientific selection. Reject a whole world/query candidate on offline qualification failure; never replace a query after model execution. Same five fixed queries for both arms.
reservation.query_order: 000,001,010,011,012 pattern order; no outcome or model-dependent reorder.

runtime.decoding: greedy, thinking disabled, preserved HF tokenizer/template, fresh request KV state
runtime.invalid_discovery: Immediately stop the entire scientific campaign as a protocol failure; preserve raw outputs and receipts. No replacement probe, retry, substitute policy, or 12-probe completion claim.
runtime.invalid_prediction: Count exact, bit and step scores as zero for the entire expected trace; retain schema failure; continue fixed endpoints.
runtime.schema_mechanism: Prompt-specified strict JSON and independent exact validation; no constrained decoding, repairs, retries or critics.
runtime.technical_changes: Increase context from 1536 to 4096 and generation limit from 96 to 256; qualify only synthetically before Method Freeze. Batch reduced from 4 to 1 after synthetic-only prefill exceeded the preserved 75% GPU memory cap; no completed responses or scientific calls in failed attempt.
runtime.weights: Every parameter requires_grad=False; no optimizer or training. NF4 double quantization and BF16 compute unchanged.

selection_gate.name: INFORMATIVE_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_SUPPORTED
selection_gate.test: Across 120 paired machine cumulative-IG differences. Discard ties abs(delta)<=1e-12; exact binomial upper tail with p=.5. All ties => p=1.

world_qualification.baseline_guarantee: Constant reset or last-observation repetition cannot match any internally nonconstant trace. Any actuator-independent predictor producing one common three-step trace across queries can match at most 1/5, including arbitrary ledger-fitted or oracle-fitted predictors.
world_qualification.failure: STOP before inference; do not weaken qualifications or change seed after examining A0 results.
world_qualification.last_observation_predictor: Repeat the final sensor state of the last executed discovery probe for all three steps.
world_qualification.marginal_operational_predictor: Per-step per-sensor majority across executed discovery traces that reach that step, ties zero; fallback reset bit if no sample. Identical predicted sequence for every length-3 query.
world_qualification.oracle: Greedy maximum expected information gain over the 79 allowed probes; ties catalogue order; 12 reset probes. Offline qualification only, never Active action selection.
